security_implications: The generate loop ties the alert_req_i of all prim_alert_sender instances to the same alerts[0] signal, instead of using per‑index alerts[i]. Under any genuine alert condition on channel 0, every alert_tx_o output is asserted simultaneously, which can cause a security‑critical false‑alert storm or suppress later distinct alerts. This directly undermines alert integrity and could bypass fault‑response handling. Additionally, the unconnected alert_ack_o and alert_state_o ports may hide handshake failures if the prim_alert_sender requires an acknowledgment, potentially leaving alerts stuck or unobservable.
